newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, Dec 3 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed/in roads, 3 due. Max Recommended draft 29 ft 10 in at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max recommended draft 29 ft 9 in at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading maize, 1 loading by-products. 3 vessels in roads 15 due at 9 terminals during the coming week. Max recommended draft 34 ft 8 In. Forecast to keep rising for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Pasa berth draft 24 ft 8 in FW. Nidera berth draft 34 ft 2 in FW.

Rosario - Seven vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 2 loading sugar, 2 loading wheat, 1 loading maize. 3 vessels in roads, 9 due during coming week. Max recommended draft 34 ft 8 in, forecast to keep rising for the next week. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed/in roads, 2 due. Max recommended draft 34 ft 8 in, forecast to keep rising for the next week. Elevators berth max draft 22 ft FW. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - Four vessels berthed of which 1 discharging slabs, 1 loading steel products, 1 discharging iron ore, 1 discharging zinc, 2 vessels in roads, none due this week. Max recommended draft 34 ft 8 in, forecast to keep rising for the next week. Recommended draft guided by EM channel.

San Pedro - One berthed loading wheat, no vessels in roads/due. Recommended draft guided by EM channel. Max recommendable draft for Mitre channel at high tide is 31 ft. 6 in. Buenos Aires - 28 Vessels in port, 30 due in coming week. Max recommendable draft 31 ft 6 in FW high tide NAABSA (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock sud max recommendable draft 29 ft FW high tide NAABSA, guided by entrance channel. Necochea - No vessels berthed/in roads, 6 due during week. Max. draft 40 ft. Bahia Blanca - Three berthed of which 1 loading fish, 2 discharging fish. No vessels in roads, 11 due during the week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, Dec 3 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 container/general cargo loader/discharger, 1 malt discharger, 1 bulk malt discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 container discharger, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 cotton discharger. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 fl discharger. Praia Mole - 3 Steel plates loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel, Ubu - No vessels, 14 waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 8 full containers, 6 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger, 12 sugar loaders, 4 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 juice loaders, 1 salt discharger, 1 malt discharger, 3 chemical products, 1 sulphur discharger. 20 in roads, 81 due in next 7 days. Private terminals, Cosipa - 2 iron ore dischgers, 3 steel products loaders. Ultrafertil - 1 bulk fertiliser discharger.

Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 5 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 full container, 1 soybean discharger, 1 soyoil discharger, 1 rice loader. 3 Waiting in roads, 12 due in next 10 days. Paranagua - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo discharger, 2 fertiliser dischargers, 1 reefer discharger, 1 sugar loader, 1 container loader, 1 pellets loader, 1 reefer loader. 10 Vessels in roads of which to load, 2 sugar, 2 reefers, 1 pellets to discharge, 4 fertiliser, 1 general cargo. 23 Due in next 7 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 3 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 2 wheat, 1 steel products, 3 container/general, 1 steel products/paper, 1 garlic, 1 general, 1 general/steel products loader, 2 steel products loaders. Tecon - 3 Berthed, 29 due in next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Vessels berthed, Tebar 2, commercial quay 1. Four waiting in roads, five due in next 7 days.

CHILE, Dec 2 - Arica - Three vessels berthed and operating, 2 berths vacant. 8 Vessels due during the week. Iquique - No vessels at terminal, 6 berths vacant, 7 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - One vessels berthed, 5 berths vacant. 7 Vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo. No vessels in roads awaiting cargo. Valparaiso - Four vessels berthed and working normally, 5 berths vacant, 1 berth out of service for enlargement (pier 3) until April 1997. 16 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Four vessels in port operating, 6 berths vacant. 11 Vessels due during the week, port busy but no waiting time.

Puerto Montt - One vessel berthed, none waiting in roads, 2 due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 3 vessels and coasters due during the week. No vessels waiting in roads. Concepon Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and working normally, 1 due this week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed and working normally, no berths vacant. No vessels in roads, 5 due during the week. Navy pier (molo 500) - No vessels at terminal. Steel pier - 2 Vessels berthed and working normally, 1 in roads awaiting berth. Coronel pier - No vessels at terminal, none due during the week. Oil terminal - No vessels at terminal, none due during the week. Lirquen - No vessels berthed, 6 berths vacant, 4 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels at terminal.

PERU, Dec 2 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Four vessels anchored, 3 berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored, 1 fish meal vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco, Ilo - No vessels, no delays. Talara - One vessel anchored, 1 oil tanker berthed, no delays. Chimbote - Two vessels anchored, 1 fish meal vessel berthed, no delays.
